question: Will an open-weights model be in the top 3 on the LMArena text leaderboard on Jan 1, 2027?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if at least one open-weights model holds a rank of 1st, 2nd, or 3rd on the LMArena (Arena) text leaderboard overall category at any point strictly after 2026-10-06T17:00:30.204Z and at or before 2027-01-02T05:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if no open-weights model holds a rank of 1st, 2nd, or 3rd on the LMArena (Arena) text leaderboard overall category at any point strictly after 2026-10-06T17:00:30.204Z and at or before 2027-01-02T05:00:00.000Z.

Clarifications:
- "Open-weights model" means any model whose weights are publicly released for download without access restrictions, regardless of the license terms (e.g., commercial restrictions are permitted). A model is considered open-weights if it is widely documented as such by its developer or credible third-party sources.
- The leaderboard snapshot to use is the one published closest to (and no later than) 2027-01-02T05:00:00.000Z; if the leaderboard is updated on a schedule, the most recent update within the window applies. The overall/global category ranking (not a subcategory) determines rank.
